rationale: Class 1 single-field check on cost. The raw SOI prints the flagged negative costs as parenthesized cost values in the Cost column, with matching negative fair values for unfunded/delayed draw or revolver positions. The extracted values such as -1000 and -20000 are source-reported amounts in thousands, so C107 is a monitoring warning rather than a data error for this item.
